records.vts_boundary_basis: Sjøtrafikkforskriften (FOR-2021-02-10-523) s.6 is the complete statutory list of Norwegian VTS areas (Horten, Brevik, Kvitsøy, Fedje, Kinn, Melkøya). NCA official VTS-area geometry (WFS layer_696) compared with NCA TSS geometry (WFS layer_706, group 'mellom Runde og Utsira', layer_706.23-25 (62.83-63.02N, 3.96-4.31E)): bounding boxes disjoint, so the TSS is outside every VTS area. Nearest: Kinn VTS area (c. 50 nm). TSS-to-feature matching is by position (my inference; the WFS names only the group).
records.reporting_boundary_basis: Only Norwegian Part I system in the IMO 2025 inventory is BARENTS SRS (VRS-0009), whose southern limit is 67°10'N (SN.1/Circ.318 points A-B); this TSS lies south of 63.1°N. WETREP (VRS-0005) boundary runs along 000° in the north and does not reach Norwegian waters. Chapter 5 of the Maritime Traffic Regulations makes use of the TSS compulsory for listed ships on the stretch Halten-Utsira but imposes no reporting duty (supervision by NCA only). SafeSeaNet Norway port notification is general, not TSS-linked, and not counted.
records.evidence_summary: IMO B-II/19 'Off the coast of Norway' (consolidated 1 June 2021, S-S6), stretch Halten-Utsira (in force 2011, S-S5). Not inside any statutory Norwegian VTS area and not inside any Part I reporting area. Vardø VTS (NOR VTS) monitors tanker and risk traffic along the whole coast outside VTS areas and the NCA supervises compliance with the routeing measures (s.172), but this is surveillance outside a declared VTS area, not a VTS service area covering the TSS.

records.vts_boundary_basis: No official source found that places the TSS in a declared VTS area. The Irish Coast Guard states it monitors traffic in the Tuskar/Fastnet TSS (S-S9), but does not describe this as a VTS. Irish port VTS (e.g. Port of Cork) serve harbour approaches only and were not shown to reach the TSS. Absence of a VTS not proven, so VTS relationship left not established.
records.reporting_authority: Irish Coast Guard: MRCC Dublin (communications also via MRSC Valentia and MRSC Malin Head); other WETREP coastal States for their sectors
records.reporting_boundary_basis: MSC.190(79) para 2.1: the WETREP polygon runs 56°30'N 012°W - 54°40'41"N 015°W - 50°56'45"N 015°W - 48°27'N 006°25'W, with the inner closing point 21 on the Irish east coast (52°10'N 006°22'W). At Fastnet's longitude (c. 009°36'W) the southern boundary line lies near 49°23'N, about 2° south of the TSS, so the TSS (off Fastnet Rock, c. 51°18'-51°23'N) is wholly inside. Applies only to oil tankers >600 dwt carrying heavy crude, heavy fuel oil or bitumen/tar; WETREP does not name the TSS.
records.evidence_summary: Inside the WETREP (VRS-0005) mandatory reporting area (tankers with heavy grade oil only). The Irish Coast Guard monitors traffic in the TSS, but no declared VTS area was found covering it.
records.source_date: MSC.190(79) 2004-12-06 (in force 2005-07-01); gov.ie IRCG page modified 2025-07-08; accessed 2026-09-29
records.unresolved_issue: Whether Irish Coast Guard monitoring of the Fastnet TSS amounts to a VTS (no official VTS designation found); no official list of Irish VTS consulted to prove absence. TSS coordinates taken from a search snippet only (lead only); inclusion in WETREP rests on the boundary geometry, not on those coordinates.
records.vts_leads: Irish Coast Guard traffic monitoring of the Tuskar/Fastnet TSS (MRCC Dublin / MRSC Valentia); Port of Cork VTS (harbour only, not coverage)
records.prior_lead_outcome: n/a: no prior lead; coordinator lead WETREP confirmed; Irish Coast Guard Valentia/Malin confirmed as WETREP shore authorities, not VTS

method_notes: All sources accessed 2026-09-29. Lovdata blocked direct fetch (HTTP 405), so the NCA's current unofficial English translation (in force as of 1 July 2026) was used; the Norwegian text prevails. VTS-area test used NCA official geodata (services.kystverket.no WFS, the Kystinfo layers that s.6 incorporates by reference) with bounding-box and vertex-distance checks (shapely not available); every B16/B17 Norwegian TSS bounding box is disjoint from every VTS-area bounding box. The WFS labels TSS only by group ('mellom Runde og Utsira', 'mellom Egersund og Risør'), so each IMO TSS was matched to features by position (inference). COLREG.2/Circ.75 (2020 consolidation) could not be downloaded (mirror reset); the NCA 2021 flyer was used instead. 'Neither confirmed' for Norway rests on the statutory complete VTS-area list plus official geometry, and the IMO 2025 Part I inventory (only VRS-0009 for Norway). Fastnet TSS coordinates came from a search snippet (lead only) and were not relied on. British English; no em dashes.
